notes.title: I am changing all my games from paid to "free to play".
notes.notes:
Good day, my friends!

I decided to change all my three games from paid to "free to play".

Planned date is October 17. The day I will be married.

I want to thank everyone who bought my games. You supported me a lot.

Also, I want to give special thanks to Endy & Emily - my biggest friends, Pottow who had an awesome Dispersio run at ESA and Russian retro gamers community "DENDY FOREVER" who morally supported me through all the development.

There are few reasons for me to make my games free:
[list]
[*] Due to banking issues with Russia I can't get money from my games. Not sure how long will it take for the world to come to peace again.
[*] At first I thought $0.99 ($0.49 during sales) price will make more people play my games. "Free to play" will definitely do that. Anyway i got enough to cover the publishing fee.
[/list]

Also I want to say that I lost my domain "achpile.tk" due to dot.tk incompetence (they didn't send me email about prolonging and then I don't have it on my list and can't get it into it again).

But my email "achpile@gmail.com" is still available for your feedback.

At last... Alas i lost my gamedev passion, so there will be no more games from me most likely.

Thanks to everyone one more time!
